$comment: A derived template (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): the care pack composed with a marriage & family therapy content seed, re-registered in the groove register (a 1970s soul-duet LP sleeve) with its own pinned page skeletons. Everything else — pages' builders, sections, contract, tests — is the base pack's; compose expands this catalog through resolveCatalog (scripts/lib/pack-switch.mjs).
title: Couples & Family Therapy
description: A marriage and family therapy practice's site with real online booking: Duet Family Therapy on Sunset Boulevard in Silver Lake, art-directed as a 1970s soul-duet LP sleeve — amber light burning into cocoa, film grain, a fat rounded serif. The hero is the record cover: "Let's talk about us." beside a square photograph with a round record label (Silver Lake · Est. 2011), Side A's tracklist of sessions with real durations (couples intake 80 min, family session 50 min, premarital 6 sessions), sessions and fees as a Side A / Side B tracklist, ways to pay, a family-session story, three therapists with portraits (two LMFTs and a supervised associate), former-client words shared with consent, an FAQ on cost, superbills, and confidentiality, and a booking page offering a free 15-minute call, 80-minute intakes, and 50-minute sessions. The booking form is clinically empty — name, contact, session type, new/returning.

content.$comment: Business-content contract seed override. resolveCatalog merges a remix's content per-domain over the base's, so these practice and appointments seeds replace the base pack's at compose and mirror THIS remix's contentSeed module entry for entry (the remix-seed tests pin the twins) — the composed template's Manage editors and booking widget open on the therapy practice, not the base clinic.

providers.name: Roz Baptiste
providers.bio: Roz opened Duet in 2011 after a decade in community mental health. She works with couples at every stage — newly engaged, thirty years in, deciding whether to stay — and supervises the practice's associate. Clients say she's warm and does not let anyone off the hook.

providers.name: Marco Ibarra
providers.bio: Marco sees families with teenagers, blended families, and parents co-parenting across two houses. He's bilingual in English and Spanish and has a gift for getting a sixteen-year-old to say more than one word.

providers.name: June Kim
providers.role: Associate MFT · supervised by Roz Baptiste, LMFT
providers.bio: June works with premarital couples and partners navigating two cultures, two families, and one wedding. As a registered associate she practices under Roz's supervision, and she keeps a few reduced-fee hours each week.

services.name: Couples therapy
services.description: For partners who keep having the same fight. We slow it down, find what's under it, and practice a different ending — in the room, then at home.

services.name: Family therapy
services.description: Parents, kids, grandparents — whoever's in the house. Everyone gets a turn, nobody gets blamed, and the week gets a little easier.

services.name: Premarital counseling
services.description: Six sessions before the wedding: money, families, conflict, the chores nobody mentions. Structured, practical, and oddly fun.

services.name: Teens & their parents
services.description: Separate time for the teenager and for the parents, then time together. Confidential within the limits the law sets, which we explain up front.

services.name: Co-parenting after separation
services.description: For parents who are done as partners but not as parents. One plan, two households, fewer handoffs in the driveway.

services.name: Discernment counseling
services.description: A short, structured process for couples where one partner is leaning out. Five sessions or fewer to decide — together — what comes next.

locations.label: Sunset Boulevard
locations.address: 3208 Sunset Boulevard, Suite 2, Los Angeles, CA 90026

reviews.quote: We came in barely speaking. Roz made us slow down until we could actually hear each other, then made us practice it every week. We still do the Sunday check-in she taught us.
reviews.name: D. & T.
reviews.detail: Former couples clients, shared with consent

reviews.quote: Marco got our fifteen-year-old to laugh in the first session. By the fifth, she was the one reminding us it was Tuesday.
reviews.name: The R. family
reviews.detail: Former family clients, shared with consent

reviews.quote: June asked the questions nobody at the wedding shower did — about money, about my mother, about who does the dishes. Best six sessions we spent all year.
reviews.name: A. & S.
reviews.detail: Former premarital clients, shared with consent

newPatient.title: A free 15-minute call
newPatient.body: Tell us a little about what's going on and who'd come. We'll suggest the right therapist, or refer you elsewhere if we're not the fit.

newPatient.title: Your Good Faith Estimate
newPatient.body: Before the first session you'll get a written estimate of what care is expected to cost, as federal law requires for self-pay clients.

newPatient.title: The first session
newPatient.body: Couples intakes run 80 minutes, family intakes the same. We'll ask how you met, what's working, and what brought you in now.

newPatient.title: After that
newPatient.body: Most couples meet weekly or every other week for a few months. You'll get a superbill each month if you use out-of-network benefits.

types.name: Free 15-minute call
types.description: A phone call to see if we're the right fit before anything else.

types.name: Couples or family intake
types.description: The long first session, for everyone who's coming.

types.name: Session
types.description: An ongoing session with your therapist, in person or by video.

theme.$comment: The groove register in its own burnt orange: mode dark opens the site in the register's native appearance (the sleeve's front — amber into cocoa, cream type); the Feel toggle swaps to the authored cream back cover. Marketing pages resolve brand over preset accent, so the overlay re-inks pages and app surfaces together. navigation re-pins the shared careShell chrome (a declared theme variant outranks the shell prop): care-direct wears the full-width sign band, care-psychology-studio the split letterhead, care-dental-bright the pill cluster — so the therapy practice takes the centered masthead, the sleeve's title strip.

landing.$comment: A pinned layout (packs/README.md 'Derived templates'): style re-registers the base's pages in the groove register, and pages carries exactly the skeletons careLanding.ts emits from this remix's contentSeed — the content-gated sections (menu, spotlight, faq) appear because the seed fills them — so the composed template's document reproduces its code config section for section (tests/View/Care/careLanding.test.ts reads this through composedLandingSeed).
